declaration.preface:
Quality Rubbers is committed to conducting its procurement activities in a responsible, ethical, and sustainable manner. The Company recognizes that procurement decisions have a significant impact on environmental, social, and economic outcomes across the value chain and therefore seeks to integrate responsible sourcing practices into all procurement processes.

This policy establishes the intent to procure goods and services in a manner that promotes transparency, fairness, and accountability while ensuring alignment with applicable laws, regulations, and organizational standards. It reflects the Company’s commitment to working with suppliers and business partners who uphold ethical business conduct, respect human rights, maintain safe working conditions, and adopt environmentally responsible practices.

The policy aims to strengthen supplier selection, evaluation, and engagement processes by incorporating sustainability considerations, including environmental performance, labor practices, health and safety, and ethical governance. It also promotes traceability, risk assessment, and continuous improvement across the supply chain.

Through this policy, Quality Rubbers seeks to build long-term partnerships with responsible suppliers, minimize procurement-related risks, and contribute to sustainable development by ensuring that sourcing practices remain consistent, transparent, and aligned with global best practices.
declaration.declaration:
Quality Rubbers recognizes that procurement activities have a significant impact on environmental sustainability, social responsibility, and ethical business conduct across the supply chain. The Company is committed to integrating these considerations into supplier selection, evaluation, and engagement processes.

We aim to promote responsible sourcing by engaging with suppliers who demonstrate environmentally sustainable practices, including efficient use of energy, water, and raw materials.

We aim to encourage suppliers to reduce environmental impacts by minimizing emissions, waste generation, and pollution across their operations.

We aim to support traceability and transparency in sourcing practices, including responsible procurement of raw materials and avoidance of environmentally sensitive or high-risk sources.

We aim to promote compliance with applicable environmental laws, regulations, and standards across the supplier base.

We aim to encourage suppliers to adopt fair labor practices, including prohibition of child labor, forced labor, and any form of exploitation.

We aim to promote safe and healthy working conditions within the supply chain by encouraging suppliers to implement appropriate health and safety practices.

We aim to support fair wages, reasonable working hours, and humane treatment of workers across supplier operations.

We aim to encourage diversity, non-discrimination, and respect for human rights across all supplier workplaces.

We aim to promote ethical business conduct by ensuring zero tolerance for bribery, corruption, and fraudulent practices within the supply chain.

We aim to encourage transparency, accountability, and compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements among suppliers.
declaration.scope:
This policy applies to all employees, workers, directors, officers, contractors, and any third parties acting on behalf of Quality Rubbers. It also extends to all suppliers, vendors, service providers, and business partners engaged in procurement-related activities.

The policy covers all procurement and sourcing activities associated with the Company’s operations, including the sourcing of raw materials, processing-related inputs, storage, handling, transportation, and distribution. It further applies to all interactions with suppliers, contractors, regulatory authorities, and other relevant stakeholders involved in the procurement lifecycle.

policy.monitoring:
At Quality Rubbers, monitoring and reporting are integral to ensuring effective implementation of responsible procurement practices and continuous improvement across the supply chain. Structured processes are maintained to track, review, and communicate procurement performance in relation to environmental, social, and ethical standards.

Performance Tracking: Supplier-related parameters, including ESG compliance, supplier performance, sourcing practices, and procurement spend distribution, are regularly monitored against defined performance indicators.

Periodic Reviews: Procurement and supplier performance data is reviewed at defined intervals to assess progress, identify gaps, and support informed decision-making.

Internal Audits: Periodic internal audits and supplier assessments are conducted to evaluate compliance with responsible procurement requirements and the effectiveness of sourcing controls.

Data Integrity and Documentation: Accurate records and documentation systems are maintained to ensure reliability, consistency, and traceability of supplier and procurement data.

Stakeholder Communication: Engagement is maintained with suppliers, employees, and relevant stakeholders to share expectations, address concerns, and strengthen transparency in procurement practices.

Performance Disclosure: Responsible procurement performance and key initiatives are communicated through internal reporting systems and external disclosures, where applicable.
policy.reviewMechanism:
The Responsible Procurement Policy is subject to periodic review to ensure its continued relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with applicable regulatory requirements and organizational objectives.

The Procurement Head is responsible for coordinating the review process.

The policy is reviewed at least once every year, or earlier if required, based on regulatory changes, supply chain developments, or stakeholder feedback.

The review process includes assessment of supplier compliance status, progress against responsible procurement objectives, and identification of improvement opportunities.

Necessary updates and revisions are implemented to strengthen the policy and ensure alignment with evolving best practices and sustainability standards.
